sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/349 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 349, search/grid facilities 437 'Sites 1-139' and 438 'Sites 140-257' for 2027-06-15, 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12, search/details for every unit on 2027-06-15, plus sites 001, 142 and 243 on 2027-06-19, 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Non-electric sites $29 a night, electric $39, full hookups $52, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) non-electric $25, electric and full-hookup $35. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Findley campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Non-Electric 29.00 with Maximum Camping Unit Length 31-61 and trailer map icons, Campsite Electric 39.00, Campsite Full Hookup 52.00, Fee 6.50); sites 001, 142, 243 on Sat 2027-06-19 (29.00 / 39.00 / 52.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (25.00 / 35.00 / 35.00), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (electric sites list Electricity Hookup '50,30,20'; the 15 full-hookup sites list Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'Yes') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/findley-state-park-campground ('15 full service sites', '91 electric sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 254 web-bookable sites (149 non-electric, 90 electric, 15 full hookup), all back-in, rated for camping units 31-70 ft (non-electric mostly 36-49, electric 45-58, full hookups 42-48). Sites 1-139 are the all-non-electric area; electric and full-hookup sites are in 140-257. ODNR counts 15 full-service, 91 electric and 151 non-electric sites, plus three camper cabins and two group camps. Pets permitted on all sites; three tents per site.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid (437: 138 units, 438: 122 incl. cabins, group camps and a shelter) + search/details (PullInTypeName 'Back In', Maximum Camping Unit Length 31-70, 'Tents Allowed: 3 tent limit.') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/findley-state-park-campground ('two camping areas — one with a mix of full-service, electric and non-electric campsites, and the other will all primitive campsites'; '15 full service sites', '91 electric sites', '151 non-electric sites'; 'Pets are permitted on all sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Camp store open April through November (440-647-0534).

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/findley-state-park-campground ('Showers, flush toilets, laundry facilities, dump station'; 'Camp Store open April through November; 440-647-0534'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: In winter ReserveOhio sells only part of sites 140-257 (87 of 122 units free in January 2027); sites 1-139 are blocked.

season.source: ReserveOhio search/grid 2027-01-12 (facility 437: all 138 units blocked; facility 438: 87 free, 35 blocked), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'Reservations are required for all sites and may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.' Every listed campsite is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio. Camper cabins need two nights.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/findley-state-park-campground ('Reservations are required for all sites and may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.'; camper cabins 'require a two-night stay') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-30

summary: Fees confirmed ($29 non-electric RV base, electric +$10, full hookup +$23) and added the off-peak rates. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at the 15 full-hookup sites, 254 back-in sites rated to 70 ft, showers/flush toilets/dump/laundry/camp store, year-round (part of 140-257 in winter), ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, reservations required, 14-night max. AWH note kept verbatim. Pin 530 m from the sites' centroid. Not stated: the weekend minimum (left inherited).
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page lists (440) 647-5749 (the park page gives it as the Park Office); the camp store / nature center is (440) 647-0534.
Pin 530 m off (127 m from the nearest site, at the north end). Centroid of ReserveOhio's 259 campsite coordinates: 41.12664,-82.20877.
